name: Colony Hotel · survey pilot
description: County 3D geometry checked against the 2021 laser survey. The facade sign and horizontal bands follow the hotel’s own exterior reference; smaller proportions and materials are interpreted.

name: Fontainebleau
description: A curved hotel wing interpreted with horizontal bands. The complete hotel complex and exact facade have not been reconstructed.

name: Oceanfront lifeguard tower
description: A representative Miami Beach lifeguard tower, placed approximately on the oceanfront. This is a generic artistic asset, not a specific surveyed tower.

name: Miami Beach City Hall
description: A camera stop at the civic center. The surrounding buildings use GIS footprint massing; a custom verified City Hall model is still pending.

name: South Pointe
description: The southern end of Miami Beach at Government Cut. Park geometry and water boundaries follow the downloaded public datasets.

name: Normandy Isles
description: A neighborhood camera stop in the northern bay islands. Buildings, streets and mapped trees stream in as the camera approaches.
